222-527-4247-7175.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-7175.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-6495-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-6968.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-851-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2173-2292-5220-7918.description:
Cast Viscera Seer by paying its mana cost.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2021-2060-3129-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1660-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1660-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Natural Affinity
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-6260.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Caradora
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-1874-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1874-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2961-3175-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

1308-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
1308-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-4559-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-4559-5330-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

338-4050-5086-5183-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4050-5086-5183-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

3532-4928-5078-6747.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
You control another artifact.
3532-4928-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3789-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1472-2438-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-2438-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-5315-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-5315-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

2459-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

985-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2558-6291-6757-6797.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-6291-6757-6797.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Phantom Train to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

983-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands.
Temple of the False God and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
983-1825-6760.description:
Activate Temple of the False God and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Temple of the False God and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

1170-1645-2397-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1580-4871-5334.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2593-3622-4067-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gravedigger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Gravedigger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Gravedigger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

570-1770-2608--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
570-1770-2608--108.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Holding priority, activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-1770-2608--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

3263-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
3263-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6167.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6167.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Ior Ruin Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Ior Ruin Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2043-2757-3263-4893.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic land.
2043-2757-3263-4893.description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Training Grounds token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Urza by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Training Grounds token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Urza by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Training Grounds that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 6.

1242-1950-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1950-4702.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate the nontoken Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

276-1506-3059.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Malignus.
Malignus does not have summoning sickness.
276-1506-3059.description:
Activate Malignus by tapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to twice its power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

1947-2218-4763.notablePrerequisites: Ronin Warclub attached to Reckless Barbarian.
1947-2218-4763.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Koll triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Reckless Barbarian.
Repeat.

1707-4050-4776.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You have the highest life total.
1707-4050-4776.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Last Laugh, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-3507.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers, holding priority, cycle Dismantling Wave by paying {6}{W}{W}, destroying all artifacts and enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

uses.n: Hidetsugu Consumes All // Vessel of the All-Consuming

1506-3038-3531.notablePrerequisites:
Colossification and Burning Anger attached to Vessel of the All-Consuming.
Vessel of the All Consuming does not have summoning sickness.
1506-3038-3531.description:
Activate Vessel of the All-Consuming by tapping it, dealing at least 23 damage to any opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming's first and second ability trigger.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Vessel of the All-Consuming's second trigger, causing that opponent to lose the game.

225-3573-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
You control at least two artifacts.
225-3573-4222.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
